tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=2 lw=1 sw=1 sfclay=1 sf_surface=2 bl_pbl=1, ysu_topdown_pblmix on) dumped by the instrumented fork (module_esm_dump), replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) standalone kernels/ysu_driver of the ctessum-claude/WRF fork. Inputs are the dumped kernel arguments (single-precision values widened), column 1 of the tile. Tendencies: the kernel integrates the diffusion implicitly, so its finite-step tendency (f - c)/dt is not the instantaneous right-hand side; the expected values are the second-order Richardson extrapolation (8 T(dt/4) - 6 T(dt/2) + T(dt))/3 of the replays at dt = 0.04, 0.02, 0.01 s, which recovers the dt -> 0 limit to about 1e-8 of the column maximum (measured: the dt = 0.01 and 0.001 s replays differ by up to 9e-4 relative in theta, 7e-5 in u; successive first-order extrapolants agree to 3e-5). The kernel is compiled with NEED_B4B_DURING_CCPP_TESTING = 1, under which ttnp is a TEMPERATURE tendency (theta tendency times the Exner function), so the theta reference is ttnp/pi2d. Diagnostics (hpbl, kpbl, wstar, delta, exch_hx, exch_mx) are step-independent and taken from the dump. Residual mismatch between this component and the kernel (measured over all four tests): hpbl <= 4e-8 relative, wstar/delta <= 3e-8, K profiles <= 5e-6 m^2/s absolute, tendencies <= 2.2e-10 K/s or m/s^2 and <= 5e-14 1/s (qv) absolute, i.e. 1e-7 to 1e-6 of the column maxima; it comes from the real32 values of the WRF constants the kernel receives (g = 9.8100004, karman = 0.40000000596, ep1, ep2, rovcp) and from the kernel's default-real literals (h1 = 0.33333335, 6.8, 15.9, ...) which this component takes at their nominal values from lib/wrf_constants.esm and ysu_parameters.esm. Tolerances are set 5-10x above the measured mismatch. Assertions: scalar diagnostics; Linf_error of the whole interface K_h/K_m columns and of every tendency column against the inline reference column (expected 0 within the absolute tolerance); spot checks of theta, u and qv tendencies at selected layers with a relative tolerance and an absolute floor for layers whose tendency is at the extrapolation's roundoff level. Regime: first physics step of the run (call 1, 19:00 UTC start), convective: hfx = 182 W/m^2, br = -0.058, u* = 0.34 m/s, kpbl = 15, h = 871 m, thermal-excess search and entrainment active, no cloud at the top (cloud-top branch inactive).

Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=2 lw=1 sw=1 sfclay=1 sf_surface=2 bl_pbl=1, ysu_topdown_pblmix on) dumped by the instrumented fork (module_esm_dump), replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) standalone kernels/ysu_driver of the ctessum-claude/WRF fork. Regime: SYNTHETIC, Fortran-generated -- the call-120 column with a cloud deck qc = 3e-4 kg/kg and a radiative cooling rthraten = -1e-4 K/s inserted in layers 12-14 (the three layers below the boundary-layer top, kpbl = 15, h = 860 m, unchanged by the insertion), replayed through the real64 ysu_driver with ysu_topdown_pblmix on. This activates the cloud-top radiative-entrainment branch (cloudflg = 1): radsum = 23.9 W/m^2 of integrated cooling, the top-down convective scale wstar3_2, the extra entrainment we_rad, the counter-gradient term hgamt2 and the second K-profile term wscalek2, which raises the in-PBL heat diffusivity by up to a factor 4.5 (interface 14) relative to the unmodified call-120 regime and the entrainment-zone thickness from 21.0 to 22.3 m; the boundary-layer-top interface's K-profile term is zeroed because we < 0 (K_h there falls back to the background xkzminh). The SCM run itself has no cloud at kpbl-1, so this is the only regime exercising the branch. Inputs are the modified dump synthetic_cloudtop_120.json; expected values are the Richardson limit of the three replays; radsum is asserted against the same column sum evaluated directly on the dumped inputs.
